applicant.name: Mag. Bernhard Leitner
applicant.organisation: Westsicher Krankenversicherung AG, case management unit (private health insurer)

purpose: Our case management team wants to review the conditions and medications of members with chronic kidney disease as part of routine case handling. The review lets us sort cases by expected cost and adjust contact, follow-up and coverage arrangements for each member accordingly.
question: Provide pseudonymised conditions and medications for adults with chronic kidney disease.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Cohort = adults with chronic kidney disease.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.

expected.reason: The stated purpose amounts to decisions detrimental to natural persons (Art. 54(a)). Access is refused (Art. 54); a refusal is always justified to the applicant (Art. 68(9)).

judge.why: Rule 1: a private insurer sorting members by expected cost and adjusting their coverage arrangements is a detrimental insurance decision about individuals, prohibited by Art. 54.
